task_completion.description: Open the drone simulation environment in the Webots editor.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots application is open showing a drone model and a scene tree on the left.

task_completion.description: Set the surveillance_camera width to 1280 and height to 720.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the scene tree or node editor, the 'Camera' node shows 'width 1280' and 'height 720'.

task_completion.description: Set the surveillance_camera field of view to 0.7854 radians.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the scene tree or node editor, the 'Camera' node shows 'fieldOfView 0.7854'.

task_completion.description: Add a GPS sensor node named 'gps' to the drone's children.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'GPS' node is visible under the drone's 'children' list in the scene tree, with the name field set to 'gps'.

task_completion.description: Set the drone's Z translation (altitude) to 5.0 meters.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'translation' field of the drone's root node shows the third value (Z) as 5.0.

task_completion.description: Save the configured world to the specified path on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog or the file explorer shows the file being saved as '/home/ga/Desktop/surveillance_drone.wbt'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify node parameters rather than just editing text files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots scene tree and field editor.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a text file with the final content using a text editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating the 3D viewport or the hierarchical node tree of the simulator.

integrity.description: The agent used the 'File > Save World As' menu or equivalent GUI shortcut.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Webots menu or a file save dialog is visible in the trajectory.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The starting state has a camera resolution of 320x240, FOV of 1.5708, and altitude of 0.5m. The agent must change these to: Width=1280, Height=720, FOV=0.7854, and Z-translation=5.0. A GPS node named 'gps' must be added to the children list. The final file must be saved specifically to /home/ga/Desktop/surveillance_drone.wbt.
